scope: Fresh owned read-only containers run actual IKEv2 gateways under explicit AppArmor profiles. The general device profile denies the private key subtree; immutable charon and swanctl executables transition to the gateway profile that can load the keys. Non-gateway root opens are tested without reading or exporting any key bytes.

The complete effective policy and executable/profile identities must support the claims. Private credential provisioning and the host root/Docker policy loader remain trusted laboratory controls. No all-interface, host administrator, hardware tamper, approved-product or universal noninterference guarantee follows from this bounded case.
Mandatory policy is supplemental and is not asserted to be installed on the separate original native profiles or FreeBSD Inners.
